method: Manual v3 visible-ground envelopes clipped at ends by half-planes perpendicular to local curve tangent; no polygon enlargement in v4. Length=sum of curve segment lengths. Mean equivalent width=polygon area/axis length. Additional widths measured by perpendicular line/polygon intersections every 5% of axis. Geometry recomputed in exact source pixel coordinates with x=2172/2048,y=724/683 before world scaling5016/2172.
reservations: Masks designate ACTIVE PORTIONS of six continuous visible cooled-crust ground bands, not their full physical extents.
V4 clipping only removes ground from V3 polygons; no mask is expanded into terrain outside V3.

All six pass the brief's 500–1000 length and 150–250 mean equivalent width in world units; local perpendicular widths vary, so mean-width compliance is not a claim that every cross-section reaches150.
Cyan retained interval selected at fixed ~800 world length to discard the narrow terminal tips and maximize enclosed ground area; mean equivalent width exceeds150, local samples remain provided.
These are provisional manually traced ground boundaries, subject to visual review for slope and cliffs. Future lighting/effects masks must remain separate from these ground masks.

regions.active_mask_scope: Selected active portion of the continuous visible cooled crust ground band. This mask does not claim to cover its whole visible length. Ground allocation only; separate from future effects masks.

trim.method: Intersection of original provisional polygon with two half-planes whose boundaries are perpendicular to local axis tangent. Cyan offset selected by maximizing retained polygon area at fixed target length.
